newsitem.title: UK: Yemeni crude prices for Q4 deter one buyer.
newsitem.headline: Yemeni crude prices for Q4 deter one buyer.

text.p: Yemen's decision to hold prices steady into the fourth quarter have prompted one big European oil company to drop Yemeni crude from its shopping list, traders said.

Yemen's Supreme Council for Economy and Oil Affairs surprised customers earlier on Tuesday with a fax announcing its decision to roll over prices into the fourth quarter for its Masila and Marib Light crudes.
Some traders in the Far East said they believed negotiations continued amid some pressure from term lifters for a price cut.
Marib Light was kept at parity to North Sea benchmark Dated Brent crude and Masila at Dated Brent -45 cents.

"They settled at these levels and said that if people were interested they would have to pay official plus. We were far apart on the prices and so we prefer to pass in the fourth quarter and maybe come back in the first quarter," a trader for the oil company said.
